events.title: The Lounge Café prologue has been successfully released!
events.summary: The long-awaited release of the prologue is finally here. The Lounge Café demo is a prologue to the main game. You will play as Christian and experience a day in his life before retirement — prior to the events of the main game. During the demo, only a small portion of the café mechanics is presented, and you’re introduced to the atmosphere, characters, and overall direction of Lounge Café.Attention!
